bk.err.schema: This is not a Confluence Terminal backup, or it was made by a newer version.
bk.err.unsupported: This device cannot open compressed backups. Restore it in the desktop app or a current browser.
bk.err.not-set-up: This provider is not available here.
bk.err.unavailable: This provider is not available here.
bk.err.sign-in: Sign-in did not finish. Try again.
bk.err.state: Sign-in was refused because its check value did not match. Try again.
bk.err.session: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
bk.err.network: The provider could not be reached.
bk.err.download-host: Restoring from OneDrive needs its download server ({origin}), which this build does not allow yet.
bk.err.port-busy: Sign-in needs port 48787 on this computer, which another program is using.
bk.err.gateway: The local gateway did not accept the request. Reconnect with API privée (the key button in the header).
bk.err.needs-gateway: Add a bucket key with API privée (the key button in the header) first.
bk.err.foreign: This sign-in was meant for the phone app or has expired. Start it again from Cloud backup.
bk.err.partial: Restore stopped part-way: {n} items were written. Running the same restore again is safe.
bk.uploadAuditFailed: The backup was uploaded, but its audit entry could not be written.
bk.skippedReplay: {n} replay ledger rows are not backed up (only live rows are).
bk.restore.records: Measured outcomes: {outcomes} rows, {oadded} new. Universe snapshots: {universes}, {uadded} new. Recorded gaps: {gaps}, {gadded} new. Trade notes: {notes}, {nadded} new.
bk.restore.notKept: {n} outcome records, universe snapshots or gaps will not be kept: their rows are not on this device or are older than it keeps, or there is no room for them. No row is removed to make room.
bk.skippedRecords: {n} other records (measured outcomes, universe snapshots, gaps or trade notes) were left out because a restore could not read them.
bk.err.too-large-plain: The backup would be about {size}, and {plain} once unpacked; the limits are 20 MB for the file and 160 MB unpacked. Export the ledger as CSV from the Ledger instead.
settings.confluenceV2: Confluence v2 line in the detail sheet (test)
v2.lineHeld: Confluence v2 (test): {label} · score {score} · held until the score is back inside ±{exit}
v2.lineNote: A challenger recorded for comparison only. It never changes the list, signals, alerts or paper trades.
ledger.v2.title: Classic vs Confluence v2 (test)
ledger.v2.none: No rows with Confluence v2 in this view yet.
ledger.v2.pairs: {n} bars labelled by both engines (horizon +{h}); both are measured on the same outcomes
ledger.v2.noOutcomes: No closed outcomes on these bars yet.
ledger.v2.classic: Classic: {n} signals · hit rate {hit} · mean net {net} bp · edge {edge} bp · IC t {ic} · PSR {psr} · {churn} label changes per 100 bars
ledger.v2.v2: Confluence v2: {n} signals · hit rate {hit} · mean net {net} bp · edge {edge} bp · IC t {ic} · PSR {psr} · {churn} label changes per 100 bars
ledger.v2.notCompared: {n} rows were recorded without Confluence v2 (before WP23, or too little history) and are not compared.
ledger.v2.note: Comparison only. Classic stays the engine for the list, labels, alerts and paper trading; nothing switches over without a later owner decision.
ledger.v2.otherVersions: {n} rows carry another Confluence v2 version and are not compared.
